# add_best_optuna_trial_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_best_optuna_trial_to_rag }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Dask-parallel Optuna guest placement on RAG pockets; use serial variant when outer parallelization exists. Use `add_best_optuna_trial_to_rag_serial` instead.

```python
compute.add_best_optuna_trial_to_rag(
    rag,
    ref_coords,
    energy_interpolator,
    molecule_name,
    cluster_key='cluster_energy_pbc',
    one_per_cluster=True,
    n_trials=50,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_seed=42,
)
```

Run Optuna guest placement per pocket (Dask-parallel) and store best trials on RAG nodes.
